title: Gymnopedie No. 1 — complete performed explicit top voice

derivation.authority: The reviewed LilyPond top expression and its performanceBarMap; not a highest-note extraction from the merged-track MIDI.

licenseEvidence.editionFooter: Placed in the public domain by the typesetter; free to distribute, modify, and perform
licenseEvidence.sourceComment: Dover reproduces the original work; its copyrighted French translations are omitted from this LilyPond file.

encoding.noteEvents: Scalar MidiNoteEvent entries only: midi, startMs, durationMs. No invented velocity or performance dynamics. Each written chord is expanded to one simultaneous scalar event per pitch, preserving the source chord pitch order.
encoding.eventProvenance: Parallel to noteEvents. noteEventIndex and all *Indices fields are zero-based. sourceEventIndex, chordPitchIndex, performanceBar, sourceLine and repeatPass are one-based. sourceEventOrder is zero-based across the performed source event stream, including rests/skips.
encoding.silenceEvents: Printed R2. rests and invisible s4 skips retain their original kind and duration. Neither is encoded as a fake MIDI pitch or note. Adjacent printed rest bars remain separate events.
encoding.barBoundaries: Half-open [startMs,endMs) intervals. Bar n spans [(n-1)*3000,n*3000). A merged tied note may cross several boundaries; noteEventIndicesSustainingAtStart explicitly lists it. Events ending exactly at a boundary are not sustaining there.
encoding.ties: Merge only consecutive segments of the same MIDI pitch with an explicit preceding tieOut and incoming tieIn, at exactly contiguous source times. Retain every segment backreference. Untied repeated pitches remain distinct attacks, even if their times touch.
encoding.timeOrigin: Score start at 0 ms; all introduction silence retained. First attack at 13000 ms, second-pass first attack at 130000 ms.

tieTreatment.separateRepeatedD5Attacks: B26 event 2 and B31 event 2 each remain a new 1000 ms D5 attack after the preceding 5000 ms tied D5, on both passes.

validation.sorting: ascending startMs, then performed source event order, then pitch order inside the written chord
validation.noteDurationSumCaveat: Scalar durations count concurrent chord pitches separately; they must not be interpreted as elapsed piece duration.

uncertainties.finding: Official byte-identical inbox MIDI contains only 47 bars/141000 ms. This 78-bar schedule follows the explicit repeat/alternative source form and is not represented as an extraction from that MIDI.

The MIDI combines accompaniment and top F#4 on one channel and does not expose the source's clean 12-quarter top-voice tie. This schedule uses the explicit source tie chain on each pass; no accompaniment note events are included.

Top contains ending chords, not an independent scalar melody within them. All four pitches per chord are retained as concurrent scalar events. The resulting voice schedule is intentionally polyphonic, not a highest-note arrangement.

The requested fixed 60 BPM timing is used without rubato, fermata extension or dynamic interpolation. LilyPond dynamics/slurs are not converted to invented velocities or articulation. Optional velocity is omitted.
Derived from the previously reviewed Mutopia notation edition and its preserved source excerpt; no new Dover facsimile comparison or new official-source fetch was performed in this derivation.
